title: Instant Oatmeal, Fruit Flavored, No Added Fat

content.title: About
content.content: Instant fruit‑flavored oatmeal is a dry breakfast that can be prepared in 1–2 minutes by adding hot water or milk. It contains whole oat flakes, dried fruit pieces and natural flavorings, with no added fat. The product is convenient for travel, work and school.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Oats are one of the oldest cultivated grains, grown for more than 5,000 years.
Instant oatmeal retains most of the dietary fiber found in regular rolled oats.
Fruit pieces are usually made from dried berries and fruits, preserving some vitamins and minerals.
The lack of added fat makes the product low‑calorie while still providing a feeling of fullness thanks to fiber.
Oatmeal is a common component of sports nutrition because of its slow‑release energy.

items.title: High in fiber
items.content: Fiber supports digestion, promotes satiety and helps regulate blood sugar levels.

items.title: Source of beta‑glucans
items.content: Beta‑glucans can lower cholesterol and support the immune system.

items.title: Contains B‑vitamins
items.content: Vitamins B1, B2 and B6 are involved in energy metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Fruit adds antioxidants
items.content: Dried berries and fruits provide vitamin C and polyphenols that combat free radicals.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: No added fat makes it suitable for calorie‑restricted diets.

items.title: Oat allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to oats or to the avenin protein they contain.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Fruit flavorings can increase sugar levels; people with diabetes should monitor portion size.

items.title: Gluten cross‑contamination
items.content: Oats are often processed on the same lines as wheat, so gluten cross‑contamination is possible.

items.title: Heat‑sensitive nutrients
items.content: Very hot water can degrade some vitamin C and certain polyphenols.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Pour about 40 g of oatmeal into a bowl, add hot water or milk, stir and let stand for 1–2 minutes. You can enhance it with nuts, seeds, yogurt or fresh fruit for extra nutrition.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened package in a cool, dry place away from direct light. After opening, keep the bag tightly sealed to prevent moisture absorption.
